name: polish-verify
goal: Final polish — ensure theme and locale switches are seamless, update metadata, and verify build passes
design_constraints: Cook confirms unit-test and quality-gate choices before each phase
No breaking changes to existing API contracts or session storage
Build must pass cleanly with npm run build

steps.description: Update app/layout.tsx metadata: set title template to support Vietnamese (e.g. 'PTE Luyện tập' when locale is vi). Ensure description metadata is locale-neutral or defaults to English (server component cannot read client locale).
success_criteria: Metadata title and description are appropriate for the app

steps.description: Add CSS transition to theme switch: add a global transition rule on background-color and color properties (e.g. 150ms ease) on body, .student-shell, .side-rail, .workspace, .top-bar, .session-task-card, .reference-card, etc. so theme switching feels smooth rather than jarring.
success_criteria: Toggling theme produces a smooth color transition on all major surfaces
Transition does not cause layout shift or flicker

steps.description: Update the NAV_ITEMS constant in features/practice/constants.ts to use translation keys instead of hardcoded labels (or document that labels are now looked up by key in the shell).
success_criteria: NAV_ITEMS labels are compatible with the i18n system

steps.description: Run npm run build to verify no TypeScript errors, no CSS compilation errors, and the app builds successfully.
success_criteria: npm run build exits with code 0

steps.description: Run npm run test:unit to ensure existing tests still pass after all changes.
success_criteria: No regressions in catalog-order, contracts, session-state, or icon-mapping tests
